request: In the WPS register (columns WPS No, Process, PQR Ref, Review Date) highlight yellow the WPS No cell of every WPS whose PQR Ref is blank or whose Review Date is more than 12 months before today. Tell me how many I highlighted. Clear old highlights first so it can be run again.

On the Dispatch sheet (Dispatch No, Customer, Planned Date, Actual Date, Status) write Late in Status for every row with no Actual Date and a Planned Date before today, and On time where the Actual Date is not later than the Planned Date. Leave the other rows alone and tell me how many are Late.

In the NCR register (NCR No, Raised By, Issue Date, Category, Status) highlight in yellow the NCR No cell of every NCR that is still Open and was issued more than 30 days ago. Tell me how many. If I run it again, old highlights must not stay on NCRs that have been closed.

In the Consumable Stock sheet (Batch No, Description, Qty On Hand, Reorder Level, Remark) put Reorder in Remark where Qty On Hand is at or below Reorder Level, and clear the Remark where it is above. Tell me how many batches need reordering.

From the weld log (Weld Seam No, Welder ID, Joint Type, Weld Date, Visual) build a Welds Per Welder sheet with each welder's number of welds and how many of them were Rejected, the welder with most welds first.
From the NDE Report (Weld Seam No, Method, Result) make a Method Summary sheet that counts, for each method, how many seams are Accepted, how many are Repair and how many have no result yet.

Count the instruments in the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Type, Next Calibration Due) that are overdue, due in the next 30 days, and fine, and write the three numbers with labels on a Calibration Summary sheet. Instruments with no valid date are not counted in any of the three.

Check the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Inspection Status) against the NCR Register (NCR No, ITP No, Status). Add a column NCR Flag to the tracker if it isn't there, and put Open NCR in it for every ITP point that has an Open NCR against it. Tell me how many points are flagged.

Check the GRN sheet (GRN No, Part No, Heat No) against the Material Certs sheet (Heat No, MTC No). List on a Missing Certs sheet every GRN line whose heat number has no row in Material Certs. Heat numbers have stray spaces and mixed case, so compare them tidily.

Compare the Welder Quals list (Welder ID, Process, Expiry Date) with the Weld Log (Weld Seam No, Welder ID, Process). In the Weld Log write Not qualified in the Remark column for every weld whose welder has no qualification row for that process, and clear the Remark on the others. Tell me how many welds are Not qualified.

In the BOM sheet (Part No, Description, Required Qty) remove duplicate rows by Part No, keeping the first, and tell me how many duplicates I removed. Part numbers can have stray spaces, so don't treat 'P-100' and ' P-100 ' as different.
In the Material Certs sheet the Heat No cells have stray spaces and some are in lowercase. Make every Heat No trimmed and upper case, change nothing else, and tell me how many cells I changed.
List on a Late Jobs sheet every job in the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Due Date, Status) that is not Closed and is past its Due Date, oldest due date first, with the same headings.

Make a folder for every Job ID in the Job Tracker sheet inside the Jobs folder, and write in the Folder Status column what happened for each row (made, already there, or a problem). Never delete or overwrite anything.
List the PDF files in the Dispatch Docs folder on a File List sheet, one per row, in name order, with the file name in column A. Tell me how many files there are.

Add a sheet called Calibration Totals to the workbook (only if it isn't there already) with a formula in A1 that counts the instruments in the Calibration Tracker's Instrument ID column. Running it twice must not add a second sheet.
In the Consumable Issue sheet (Batch No, Opening Stock, Issued, Balance) put a formula in the Balance column for every data row: Opening Stock minus Issued. Excel 2016 only.

In the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Inspection Status) hide every row whose Inspection Status is Closed so that only the open points show, and tell me how many rows are visible below the headings. Running it again must show the rows that have been reopened.

I want one weekly quality tool, started with one macro, that (1) lists on an Overdue NCRs sheet every Open NCR older than 30 days from the NCR Register (NCR No, Issue Date, Status), (2) lists on a Calibration Due sheet every instrument in the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Next Calibration Due) due within 15 days or already overdue, and (3) writes both counts with labels on a Weekly Summary sheet. All three output sheets are rebuilt every run.

One tool for weld follow-up, started with one macro: (1) highlight in red the weld log rows (Weld Seam No, Welder ID, Visual) whose Visual isn't Accepted, (2) copy those rows to a Weld Exceptions sheet with the same headings, and (3) write on a Welder Exceptions sheet how many exceptions each welder has, most first. Both output sheets are rebuilt every run.
